title: ICAB Chartered Accountancy (CA)
body: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh (ICAB)
summary: The ICAB CA qualification comprises 17 examinations (1,600 marks total) across Certificate (600 marks), Professional (700 marks), and Advanced (300 marks) levels, mandatory hands-on practical IT lab classes, articleship at an approved CA firm, and ethics training. Built on the Design Down Methodology (DDM) with embedded ESG, AI, and cybersecurity themes.

grad.name: Graduate (Honours / Masters)
grad.blurb: For graduates and post-graduates in any discipline. Articleship duration is 3 years, with exams taken in parallel.

nodes.name: Meet Academic Criteria
nodes.description: Graduation or post-graduation in any discipline with at least 7 points in total and at least 2 points at each level up to graduation from a recognised university (CGPA 3.0+ = 3 points, CGPA 2.0-2.99 = 2 points).

nodes.name: Claim University Exemptions (CPL)
nodes.description: If your university department has an ICAB MoU or Credit for Prior Learning (CPL) agreement (e.g. DU, JU, JnU, CU, RU, BUP, NSU, BRAC), submit transcripts to claim subject-wise Certificate Level exemptions.

nodes.name: Register with an Approved CA Firm
nodes.description: Secure a position as an articled student at an ICAB-approved Chartered Accountancy firm. Disburses the mandatory monthly student allowance prescribed by ICAB.

nodes.name: Pre-Articleship Training Course (PATC)
nodes.description: Mandatory 1-month intensive course on Audit & Assurance fundamentals and English business communication before commencing firm client duties.

nodes.name: Complete 3-Year Articleship
nodes.description: Undergo 3 full years (36 months) of supervised audit, tax, advisory, and accounting practical training at the firm alongside examination attempts.

nodes.name: Accounting
nodes.description: Foundations of financial accounting, double-entry mechanics, trial balances, and statutory financial statement preparation under IFRS. Integrates ethical considerations for preparers, fair presentation overrides, introduction to ISSB sustainability reporting, and Public Financial Management (PFM) fundamentals.

nodes.name: Assurance
nodes.description: Fundamentals of audit and assurance services, internal control mechanisms, and professional scepticism. Introduces double materiality, assurance on non-financial metrics and sustainability reports, risk assessment with IT and ESG implications, remote auditing techniques, and IESBA/ICAB ethical codes.

nodes.name: Business, Technology and Finance

specificationGrid.area: Key issues for the accounting profession & technology

nodes.description: Organisational governance, business functions, financial markets, and capital finance basics. Features a 55% focus on key issues for the profession and technology, including digital business models, cloud computing platforms, cybersecurity, and corporate social responsibility (CSR).

nodes.name: Management Information
nodes.description: Cost accounting methodologies, budgeting techniques, variance analysis, and operational decision support systems. Highlights a 35% weighting on evaluating the external commercial environment, KPI benchmarking, and data-driven management performance.

nodes.name: Principles of Taxation

specificationGrid.area: Value Added Tax (VAT), Supplementary Duty & Customs

nodes.description: Comprehensive fundamentals of Bangladesh fiscal statutes updated to the Income Tax Act 2023, VAT and Supplementary Duty Act 2012, withholding taxes, return filing compliance, and anti-money laundering (AML) detection.

nodes.name: Business Laws

specificationGrid.area: Contract Act 1872 & Sale of Goods Act 1930

nodes.description: Fast-paced 1-hour objective assessment (50 marks) covering statutory commercial frameworks: Companies Act 1994 (formation, administration, winding-up), essential commercial contracts, sale of goods, negotiable instruments (cheques, dishonour), and partnership rights.

nodes.name: Information Technology

linkedRoadmaps.title: Certificate IT Practical Labs
linkedRoadmaps.description: 2 hands-on workshops: QuickBooks/Sage ERP setup & Applied Financial Excel Modeling.

nodes.description: Information systems architecture, SDLC, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity foundations, and disaster recovery (50 marks / 1.0 hr). Assessment is conducted via computer-based objective and scenario testing.

nodes.name: Financial Accounting and Reporting
nodes.description: Advanced financial statement preparation under IFRS/IAS, complex group consolidations, public sector accounting standards (IPSAS), and Islamic accounting frameworks for Shariah-compliant financial products.

nodes.name: Audit and Assurance
nodes.description: Professional audit execution under International Standards on Auditing (ISA), risk assessments, testing automated application controls, forensic fraud detection, audit documentation, and independent reporting.

nodes.name: Business Planning: Taxation & Compliance

specificationGrid.area: Advanced corporate income tax & transfer pricing
Customs Act, tariffs & cross-border fiscal policy

nodes.description: Strategic corporate tax planning, transfer pricing documentation under OECD guidelines, international cross-border tax treaties, customs valuation, tax appeals, tribunal procedures, and fiscal dispute resolution.

nodes.name: Financial Management
nodes.description: Advanced capital budgeting, DCF valuation, cost of capital, dividend decisions, currency and interest rate derivative hedging, alongside Islamic financial instruments (Sukuk, Mudarabah, Murabaha) and sustainable green financing.

nodes.name: Business Strategy and Technology
nodes.description: Corporate strategic analysis, competitive positioning, platform business models, AI and technology adoption, corporate sustainability strategies, and operational performance tracking.

nodes.name: Corporate Laws and Practices

specificationGrid.area: Banking Companies Act & financial institution laws

nodes.description: Regulatory compliance under the Bangladesh Companies Act 1994, BSEC corporate governance guidelines, Financial Reporting Act 2015 / FRC oversight, Banking Companies Act, and corporate secretarial practices.

nodes.name: IT Governance

specificationGrid.area: IT policies, legal framework & professional ethics
MIS & emerging technologies (AI, Blockchain, Big Data)

linkedRoadmaps.title: Professional IT Practical Labs
linkedRoadmaps.description: 3 hands-on workshops: Power BI/AI, Cybersecurity Forensics & Core Banking CAATs.

nodes.description: Extended 4.0-hour technical examination covering IT policies, ICT Act, COBIT, ISO 27001 governance frameworks, cybersecurity architecture, digital forensics, and IS auditing under ISACA standards.

stages.title: Advanced Level (AL)
stages.subtitle: 2 integrated strategic papers & the Capstone Case Study (300 marks total)

nodes.name: Corporate Reporting
nodes.description: Advanced financial reporting integrating multi-entity group accounting, forensic statement diagnostics, external audit execution, and sustainability reporting under IFRS S1/S2 and IAASB ISSA 5000.

nodes.name: Strategic Business Management and Leadership
nodes.description: Executive decision-making synthesizing business strategy, corporate finance, enterprise risk management (ERM), digital leadership, and ethical governance at the senior boardroom level.

nodes.name: Case Study
nodes.description: The 4.5-hour capstone simulation placing candidates in the role of a trusted C-suite advisor. Dissects an unseen real-world business case to prepare an integrated board-level diagnostic report covering strategic choices, financial feasibility, risk management, and ethical safeguards.

nodes.name: Ethics & Professional Development
nodes.description: Complete mandatory professional ethics modules, IESBA Code of Ethics assessments, and continuous professional development (CPD) onboarding requirements.

nodes.name: ICAB Associate Membership (ACA)
nodes.description: Submit articleship practical training logbook verification and official exam transcripts to be formally admitted as an Associate Chartered Accountant (ACA).

hsc.name: HSC / A Level
hsc.blurb: Direct entry route after HSC, A Level, or equivalent. Articleship duration is 4 years (3.5 years for high A Level achievers).

nodes.name: Academic Merit Requirements
nodes.description: Minimum aggregate GPA 8.0 in SSC & HSC combined (min. GPA 3.5 each), or minimum 36 O Level points (5-7 subjects) and 12 A Level points (up to 3 subjects).

nodes.name: Register with an Approved CA Firm
nodes.description: Join an ICAB-approved firm directly. Fast-track to 3.5 years if achieving Grade A in three A Level subjects with required O Levels.

nodes.name: Pre-Articleship Training Course (PATC)
nodes.description: Mandatory 1-month course on Audit & Assurance fundamentals and English business communication.

nodes.name: Complete 4-Year Articleship
nodes.description: 4 full years (48 months) of hands-on articleship training concurrently with examination attempts (3.5 years for high A-Level achievers).

pas.name: Pre-Articleship Student (PAS)
pas.blurb: For enrolled university students. Sit exams up to Professional Level before joining a firm, unlocking shortened articleship (2.5 or 2 years).

nodes.name: Verify PAS Eligibility
nodes.description: Must be currently enrolled in an undergraduate or post-graduate program at a recognised university and meet general academic point criteria.

nodes.name: Register as PAS & Attend Coaching
nodes.description: Register under the PAS wing. Maintain at least 50% mandatory class attendance per paper to earn examination eligibility.

nodes.name: Apply Academic Exemptions (CPL)
nodes.description: If your university department has an ICAB agreement, claim eligible exemptions early so you can advance to higher papers.

stages.title: Transition to Articleship
stages.subtitle: Shortened duration based on papers cleared

nodes.name: Join CA Firm within 1 Year
nodes.description: PAS exam credits remain valid for 1 year from your final university exam date. Join an approved firm within this window.

nodes.name: Pre-Articleship Training Course (PATC)
nodes.description: Complete the mandatory 1-month course prior to starting work.

nodes.name: Shortened Articleship Period
nodes.description: Articleship is reduced to 2.5 years (30 months) if Certificate Level is completed, and down to 2 years (24 months) if Professional Level is completed.

pro.name: ACCA / ICMAB Members
pro.blurb: Direct pathways for ACCA affiliates/members and ICMAB ACMA/FCMA members. Major exemptions and 2-year articleship.

stages.title: Check Eligibility & Exemptions
stages.subtitle: Credit for Prior Learning (CPL) for qualified members

nodes.name: Verify Qualified Membership Status
nodes.description: Must hold full ACCA membership/affiliate status or ICMAB ACMA/FCMA designation (excluding reciprocal pathways via third bodies).

nodes.name: Claim 7 Certificate + Selected PL Papers
nodes.description: 100% exempt from all 7 Certificate papers. ICMAB: exempt from PL Business Strategy, Corporate Law, IT Governance. ACCA: exempt from PL Business Strategy, IT Governance, and Audit & Assurance (if AAA completed in ACCA).

nodes.name: Register with an Approved CA Firm
nodes.description: Register under an approved ICAB principal for the specialized 2-year articleship term.

nodes.name: Pre-Articleship Training Course (PATC)
nodes.description: Complete mandatory 1-month training course in audit and communication.

nodes.name: Complete 2-Year Articleship
nodes.description: 24 months of specialized articleship training (can be completed concurrently or following PL exam attempts).

nodes.name: Financial Accounting and Reporting
nodes.description: Complex IFRS/IAS standards, group accounts, consolidated statements, and practical accounting scenarios. Mandatory paper for both ACCA and ICMAB members.

nodes.name: Audit and Assurance
nodes.description: Audit execution under International Standards on Auditing (ISA). Required for all ICMAB members; required for ACCA members unless exempt via ACCA Advanced Audit and Assurance (AAA).

nodes.name: Business Planning: Taxation & Compliance
nodes.description: Corporate tax planning, fiscal compliance, assessments, appeals, transfer pricing, and VAT administration in Bangladesh. Required for both ACCA and ICMAB members.

nodes.name: Financial Management
nodes.description: Capital budgeting, cost of capital, dividend policy, financial restructuring, derivative hedging, and Islamic financial modes. Required for both ACCA and ICMAB members.

nodes.name: Corporate Laws and Practices
nodes.description: Bangladesh Companies Act 1994, SEC guidelines, FRA 2015 / FRC oversight, and winding-up procedures. Required for ACCA candidates; exempt for ICMAB members.
